T_cut_I_open.rule: transport document covers it; no full information cut does (a mobile-data-only order is a thinner edge, not a cut one)

T_open_I_cut.rule: full information cut covers it; no transport document does

both_cut_edges_only.rule: both documents cover it, it filed nothing inside the window, no closure

both_cut_read_inside.rule: both documents cover it, it filed inside the window, no closure

object_absent.rule: a closure, curfew or strike document covers it and it filed nothing in its window, or every filing in the window has zero arrivals: what is missing is the price itself, and no edge is described

ordinary.rule: neither edge document covers the market

unverified.rule: an edge document of the event is not checked against a source

did_not_grow.rule: it does not: the copies stayed where the cut left them, and the registered consequent does not hold on this unit

grew.rule: dispersion at the end of the window exceeds dispersion at the cut by more than one grid step: the registered consequent holds

unread.rule: fewer than three markets of one variety, or the premise is false, or the count of both-cut units moves on the knob sweep: no verdict
